correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the proof for uniform labelled GL_n(F₂). The independent vectors e_k² force the supports of images of distinct natural-basis vectors to be disjoint; invertibility makes the automorphism matrix monomial, hence a permutation over F₂. Preservation of squares is equivalent to commuting with the structure matrix. For a transposition write P=I+N with N a single rank-one nilpotent block, Nv=u and N zero on u and the n−2 complementary vectors. A commuting map sends u to au, v to bu+av+w, and a complement vector x to Dx+λ(x)u. Ordering the basis as u, complement, v gives block-triangular determinant a² det D, so the invertible count is 2^(2n−3)|GL_(n−2)(2)|. Dividing by |GL_n(2)| gives the stated probability, including n=2. In the full matrix space, an invariant matrix is constant on simultaneous ordered-pair orbits. For a permutation moving k letters in s nontrivial cycles, the codimension is at least 2(n−k)(k−s)+k²/2, since all orbits on moved–moved ordered pairs have size at least two. The union bound for 3≤k≤n/2 starts at n³2^(−9n/4), and for k>n/2 is bounded by n!2^(−n²/8); the positive lower bound on invertibility preserves negligibility. Two distinct transpositions imply a three-cycle or a double transposition, with respective codimensions 4n−6 and 4n−8 by counting the orbits on their three or four moved letters and the pairs with fixed letters. Thus O(n⁴) intersections are negligible in Bonferroni. This yields the stated leading probability and, conditionally, exactly one nonidentity element, a natural-basis transposition. The finite enumeration code was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The result is for labelled matrix-uniform sampling, not isomorphism-class-uniform sampling or larger fields.
